nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Tomas and Grandma cut bamboo and glue paper in the shed. She shows him how to balance the kite frame.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Tomas runs across the yard. The kite lifts a little then drops. He feels the wind.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Tomas glues feathers on the tail. Grandma smiles. The kite looks colorful and ready.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='The kite shoots up. A gust tilts it left. Tomas must choose fast how to adjust.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='The kite stays close to the ground. The wind is soft. Tomas can add something or fly like this.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='After decorating, Tomas launches high. The extra feathers flutter. He must decide next.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='The decorated kite flies low. It bobs nicely. Tomas can add weight or leave it plain.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Grandma ties a paper tail. The kite feels heavier but more balanced.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='They leave the kite plain. It is light and quick in the air.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Grandma adds a small clip. The kite sits lower now.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The kite stays light. Tomas feels every puff of wind.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Tomas adds a long, colorful tail. It drags behind.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The feathers are light. The kite dances in the breeze.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='A small weight makes the decorated kite steady. Tomas likes the feel.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The plain kite is simple. Tomas watches it fly.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Tomas holds the line. The wind tugs. He prepares to decide.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The kite flies steadily. Tomas feels a change coming.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The kite goes up and down. Tomas watches the wind shift.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Tomas grips the line. The kite is ready for a final move.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Tomas pulls the line. The kite strains and creaks. He must make a final choice.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The kite glides smoothly. A stronger breeze hints of change.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='High above, the kite loops. Tomas sees the festival field below.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Tomas prepares to land. The kite is close. He must act quickly.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Tomas yanks or loosens. The kite wobbles. He makes his move.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Tomas can fly on or tweak the tail. The wind is tricky.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Tomas decides to go higher or bring it down. The wind gusts.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Tomas stops to land or runs to catch the breeze. The kite swoops.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Tomas pulls too hard. The string snaps and the kite flies away. He sighs.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Tomas lets slack. The kite steadys and soars high. A beautiful flight.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Tomas keeps flying. The kite bobs gently. Grand ma smiles. A peaceful afternoon.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Tomas ties a knot to adjust the tail. The kite flies straighter. He learns a new trick.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Tomas launches higher. The kite catches a thermal and soars. The festival crowd cheers.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Tomas reels fast. The kite dips behind a tree. It is lost in the branches.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Tomas lands the kite carefully. It rests on the grass. They pack up for the festival.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Tomas runs. The kite swings into a bush. The tail tears. He pauses.'>>
